info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizdoc-List Hotel Loyalty Points Partners-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Partners API enables users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of partners associated with hotel loyalty points programs. This endpoint is crucial for developers integrating loyalty rewards within their applications, allowing them to present users with different options for earning and redeeming points. Whether for mobile applications or web platforms, typical consumers include travel agencies, hotel management systems, and loyalty program apps seeking to enhance their offerings. By utilizing this API, businesses can improve customer engagement and streamline the rewards process for their users.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of partners associated with points.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the list of partners linked to point systems. It provides essential data for understanding partner offerings and presence.
